description: HTML login page for MedGuard application at /login. Presents username and password input fields with a login button that calls JavaScript function to POST credentials.

endpoints: POST /login - Accepts JSON with username/password, returns {message: string, userID: int}

notes: GET /login returns HTML form (200). POST /login endpoint accepts JSON payload with username and password. Response includes message field and userID on success. Login fails with 'Invalid credentials' for test/test and admin/admin combinations. Sets userID in localStorage and redirects to /add_prescription on success.
